Nov. 3, to ENR: the bill "will help us get to 'yes' or 'no' on energy projects faster, while protecting important environmental safeguards." "We want to make it easier in America to build things." On X: "There is no negotiating with the anti-growth Left." Cites the White House CEA estimate of $250 a year in bill savings.
